issues.title: Duplicate file path found in Iceberg metadata snapshot
Metadata stop to be written after random period of time.  Commit failed, will try again next cycle.
Kafka Connect drop messages when Glue Exception is happening
Spark: MERGE INTO Statements with only WHEN NOT MATCHED Clauses are always executed at Snapshot Isolation

latest_release.name: apache-iceberg-1.12.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Build: Designate a single Gradle cache writer across CI workflows by @kevinjqliu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16356
* Core: Fix ByteBufferInputStream.read() to return -1 at EOF by @sachinnn99 in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16167
* Website: remove duplicated entries from search by @MaxNevermind in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16368
* Build: Bump pymarkdownlnt from 0.9.36 to 0.9.37 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16372
* Build: Bump datamodel-code-generator from 0.56.1 to 0.57.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16373
* Build: Bump jetty from 12.1.8 to 12.1.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16374
* Build: Bump org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc from 3.53.0.0 to 3.53.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16379
* Build: Bump github/codeql-action from 4.35.1 to 4.35.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16375
* Build: Bump actions/labeler from 6.0.1 to 6.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16378
* Core, Flink: Add UUID to DataTestBase SUPPORTED_PRIMITIVES by @joyhaldar in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16364
* Spark: Fix NPE in RemoveOrphanFiles with prefix_listing for root table location(#16350) by @liuliquan-marshal in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16351
* Core: Use ArrayList for manifest list materialization by @manuzhang in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/15640
* Spec: Clarify non-default CRS conventions by @milastdbx in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/15834
* Flink: Add decimal write/read roundtrip test for FlinkParquetReaders by @wombatu-kun in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16346
* Build: Bump gradle-wrapper from 8.14.4 to 8.14.5 by @huaxingao in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16381
* Spark: Add compaction only benchmark - rewrite data files by @varun-lakhyani in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16219
* Build: Speed up Spark CI with parallel test execution by @kevinjqliu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16357
* OpenAPI: Add CatalogObjectIdentifier schema by @stevenzwu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16144
* Docs: switch default docs version from nightly to latest by @MaxNevermind in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16398
* Kafka Connect: Surface commit failures instead of silently swallowing them by @yadavay-amzn in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16237
* infra: add 1.10.2 to issue template by @amogh-jahagirdar in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16404
* Doap: Update Doap to reference 1.10.2 by @amogh-jahagirdar in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16405
* Docs: Add release notes for 1.10.2 by @amogh-jahagirdar in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16406
* Docs: Fix duplicate search results by moving versioned docs out of docs_dir by @kevinjqliu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16371
* Build: Bump com.google.cloud:libraries-bom from 26.80.0 to 26.81.0 by @huaxingao in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16382
* Docs: add more to 1.10.2 release notes by @kevinjqliu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16410
* Core: Remove redundant string concatenation by @ebyhr in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16409
* Build: Let revapi compare against 1.11.0 by @aihuaxu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16412
* infra: add 1.11.0 to issue template by @aihuaxu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16413
* Doap: Update DOAP to reference 1.11.0 by @aihuaxu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16415
* Flink: Allow setting slot sharing group for fine-grained resource management in DynamicSink  by @sqd in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16065
* Build: Use major.minor versions in runtime-deps baselines by @kevinjqliu in https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16233
* CI: Make CVE scan blocking on PRs, informational on main by @kevinjqliu in https://github.com/a
